rounds.text: Naturite Agro Products Ltd is currently undergoing a significant operational transformation that is being obscured by stale market sentiment. While the stock has suffered a 51.4% decline over the last twelve months [E44], the underlying business fundamentals are showing a sharp inflection, evidenced by a 72% compounded profit growth in the trailing twelve months [E18] and an 83% surge in compounded sales growth over the same period [E16]. The company has successfully executed a major deleveraging strategy, reducing borrowings from Rs 13.81 Cr to Rs 8.89 Cr [E36], while simultaneously achieving a massive improvement in working capital efficiency, with requirements dropping from 85.0 days to 13.7 days [E53]. Furthermore, debtor days have plummeted from 146 to 62.1 days [E52], and the company generated Rs 5.41 Cr in free cash flow in March 2026 [E33]. This operational turnaround is further supported by a positive sector tailwind [E69] and a recent quarterly operating margin expansion of 3 percentage points [E28]. Conceded: the company currently trades at a high P/B of 9.95x [E1], exhibits a negative ROE of -7.58% [E8], and is currently lagging the broader market with a relative-strength rating of 19 [E43].
